title: zesty jammy venezuelan chicken bowl
description: a vibrant, energizing dish featuring chicken bouillon powder, blanch, and a hint of spice. this jammy, fluffy venezuelan-inspired bowl is perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the onion and cook for 2 minutes, or until translucent.
add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
add the chicken breast and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the skillet, then add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
in a separate pot, bring the quinoa and 2 cups of water to a boil. reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the water has been absorbed.
in a blender or food processor, combine the cooked chicken, quinoa, chicken bouillon powder, lime juice, honey, cumin, salt, and black pepper. blend until smooth.
return the mixture to the skillet with the bell pepper and stir to combine.
serve the zesty jammy venezuelan chicken bowl hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
